quotes.excerpt: Everyone see him as a man, and I still see him as my baby.
quotes.quote: This feeling, you know, everyone see him as a man, and I still see him as my baby. So it's hard to see it that just before, a little bit of kid to be a man. God, help bless them so well there. He's finding the person of his heart. Be happy. He enjoy what he's doing, and I'm just happy to be here. God gave me a chance to see him, be with him, be part of it. I take that. It's all good. I take it.
